item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 03/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With a strong easterly airstream reaching the coast of Guangdong today, it will be windier with showers over the region in the next couple of days. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled over southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 03/06 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers. Showers will be heavier over some areas with thunderstorms.
Temp range: 25 - 28 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High

Date/Month: 04/06 (Tuesday)
